settings.question: How do I get first access to the day’s catch?
settings.answer: Members can order from 5:45 AM, right after the catch lands at 5:30 AM. Public orders open only at 7:00 AM, so you always get the freshest and best selection first.

settings.question: What benefits do I get with free delivery?
settings.answer: SelFish members enjoy unlimited free delivery with no minimum order value and access to priority delivery slots, even during peak demand.

settings.question: How do SelFish Credits work?
settings.answer: You earn 10% SelFish Credits on every order. These credits can be redeemed on future purchases with no restrictions or expiry.

settings.question: Can I access rare or seasonal fish?
settings.answer: Yes. Limited and seasonal varieties are first shown to members before they are listed for regular customers.

settings.question: Can I customize my orders?
settings.answer: Your preferred cut style, boneless options, pack weight, and TruSea flavours are auto-saved for faster and personalized reordering.
